name: benchtop
description: Fast, visual Arduino Uno + ESP32 circuit simulator for debugging sketches without hardware.

scripts.start: npm run build && node apps/bridge/src/main.ts --serve apps/web/dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/bridge/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bench -- test fixtures/specs && npm run build
